current_answer: For a new visual direction, use Anthropic Frontend Design; for a code review, use Vercel Web Design Guidelines; for React or Next.js performance work, use Vercel React Best Practices. They solve different jobs, and none has been independently result-tested by this pool yet.

catalogue_card.question: Which skill fits the frontend job in front of you?
catalogue_card.text: Three first picks split the work cleanly: visual direction, UI review, and React or Next.js performance. Each is source-pinned; none is a proven result.

summary: Anthropic Frontend Design is the strongest stated fit for a deliberate new interface direction.
Vercel Web Design Guidelines is for a review pass and fetches mutable rules at review time.
Vercel React Best Practices is scoped to React and Next.js performance, not general visual design.
uncertainty: We inspected instructions and sources but did not run a shared task or benchmark.
Compatibility and installation behavior need verification per agent and source revision.
